about_the_game:
Striped raccoon needs your help! He just needs a unique style!

Every time you press a key, the curious striped raccoon will diligently rub your taskbar with his paws, as if rinsing a new find in water.

Type, click, play, work - every action you take earns you points. The more active you are, the more chances the raccoon has to find awesome accessories for his image!

What image will you help him create? Gather a collection: hats, wigs, glasses, masks, scarves, ties and dozens more crazy, stylish and just plain funny accessories! Combine them for a unique look!

Help the adorable prankster amass the biggest collection ever! The more you do at the computer, the more cool stuff he'll wear!

Item drop chance

  • Common - 88.68%*

  • Uncommon - 9.66%*

  • Rare - 1.40%*

  • Epic - 0.25%*

  • Legendary - 0.01%*

  • Seasonal** - Craft only

Crafting

  • Trade in 10 identical items of the same quality and you're guaranteed to get 1 random item of the next higher quality.

  • For example: 10 Common → 1 Uncommon; 10 Uncommon → 1 Rare;

Trading and selling

Items you get from drops and crafting can be traded and sold on the Steam Marketplace.***

* Subject to change.

** Seasonal items drop for a limited time—only during the corresponding season.

*** Time restrictions may apply. See Steam Trading and Market Restrictions for details.
